Fixed. In `src/execute.c:2592`, `--` no longer errors when no program has been given yet — it just stops option parsing, and the first argument after `--` becomes the jq program (with the rest as args/files). Verified:

- `jq --args -rn -- '$ARGS.positional[0]' bar` → `bar`
- `jq --args -rn 1 -- '$ARGS.positional[0]' bar` → `1` (unchanged behavior)
- `jq --null-input --args -- '$ARGS' foo bar baz --zorch` → positional `["foo","bar","baz","--zorch"]`

Rebuilt with `make` and ran `make check` (all 8 suites pass) plus `tests/shtest`, including the new #2919 regression tests — all pass.
